distinctions.library_entity: Instance of that schema, e.g. seringa-referencia.library.json or uti-emergencia.library.json.
distinctions.content_binding: ContentPage payload associated with one Library.
distinctions.object_extension_schema: typed_attributes contract for an object type after explicit objectization.

object_flow: CKO.LibraryObject.schema.json + object extension -> LibraryObject -> dedicated ContentPage
anti_hallucination: Do not automatically promote cards/topics into LibraryObjects.
